newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Ok Tedi copper cuts mining operations due to dry.
newsitem.headline: Ok Tedi copper cuts mining operations due to dry.

text.p: Operations at the Ok Tedi copper mine in Papua New Guinea have begun to be reduced due to an unusual dry spell that has affected shipping and production, Ok Tedi Mining Ltd said on Thursday.

"Ok Tedi Mining Ltd has begun reduction of mill throughput as a result of a prolonged and unusual dry spell that has affected shipping and production," said the company, 52.56 percent owned by the Broken Hill Pty Co Ltd.
A maintenance shutdown of one of the grinding mills planned for the future had been brought forward, while a second mill would continue to operate, it said.
"If there is no substantial rainfall, within the month mill operation and production will be severely hampered," Ok Tedi said.
